profile.behavior: Primarily herbivorous, feeding on submerged aquatic plants and algae by dabbling and upending with its long neck; occasionally grazes on grasses near water's edge. Highly social outside breeding season, often gathering in large flocks, and nomadic in response to changing water levels and climate. Forms monogamous pair bonds and both sexes assist in nest building, incubation, and cygnet care.
field_marks: All-black body plumage with curled, shaggy-edged back and wing feathers
Long, slender, S-curved neck proportionally longer than other swans
Bright red bill with a pale whitish band near the tip
Red-orange eyes contrasting with black head
White flight feathers concealed at rest, flashing prominently in flight or wing-flap displays
profile.habitat: Large freshwater and brackish wetlands, lakes, swamps, estuaries, and slow-moving rivers with abundant submerged and emergent aquatic vegetation.
